description: Score any online store live with a fresh crawl (~20 seconds). Use when `check_store_score` returns 404 or a fresh scan is explicitly requested. Use `check_store_score` instead to retrieve an existing result without crawling. Requires a full HTTP(S) URL and updates the stored store score; repeated calls can trigger new scans. For marketplace product evidence, use `check_product_trust` instead. Docs: https://docs-gobuy.pages.dev
name: scan_store
title: Scan and Score Store Live
